name: vlc-pro-android
description: VLC Pro Android app (Capacitor shell + native MediaStore scanner). Educational project, not affiliated with VideoLAN.

scripts.sync: node scripts/copy-web.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd native && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd native && ./gradlew assembleRelease
